Historian Sumit Sarkar, Delhi University Teacher, Dies

Sumit Sarkar, a historian and a teacher at Delhi University for three decades, has passed away after a prolonged illness. Born in 1939, Sarkar was recognized as a foremost Indian historian. His lectures were described as 'musical'. He was a significant figure in Indian historical scholarship.
